2026-07-17.title: CODrone: A Comprehensive Oriented Object Detection Benchmark for UAV
2026-07-17.summary: CODrone targets the poor real-flight generalization of UAV oriented-object detectors. It replaces narrowly task-specific benchmarks with images from multiple cities, lighting conditions, viewpoints, altitudes, resolutions, and a broader category set, then evaluates 22 classical and state-of-the-art oriented detectors to expose practical bottlenecks.

2026-07-17.title: Probing Deep Into Temporal Profile Makes the Infrared Small Target Detector Much Better
2026-07-17.summary: DeepPro reformulates multi-frame infrared small-target detection as one-dimensional anomaly detection along each pixel's global temporal profile. A temporal probe and lightweight signal-correlation modules exploit temporal saliency and autocorrelation while avoiding redundant spatial computation; experiments report strong robustness for dim targets and complex interference at high efficiency.

2026-07-17.title: EvolveNav: Empowering LLM-Based Vision-Language Navigation via Self-Improving Embodied Reasoning
2026-07-17.summary: EvolveNav addresses unavailable perfect chain-of-thought labels and overfitting in LLM-based vision-language navigation. It first activates navigation reasoning with curated formalized CoT supervision, then iteratively enriches supervision with the model's own reasoning and a self-reflective auxiliary task contrasting correct and wrong patterns.

2026-07-17.title: BTKD++: Beyond Teachers by Critically Distilling Knowledge from Teacher's Bias
2026-07-17.summary: BTKD++ challenges blind knowledge distillation because teacher output errors can mislead students. It partitions samples into Easy Tasks with correct teacher predictions and Hard Tasks with incorrect predictions, then uses bias elimination, bias rectification, and a dynamic curriculum to convert structured teacher errors into corrective supervision across classification, detection, and segmentation.

2026-07-17.title: Beyond Pixel Uncertainty: Bounding the OoD Objects in Road Scenes
2026-07-17.summary: DetSeg replaces fragile pixel-uncertainty thresholding with object-level OOD proposals. It detects open-world objects, suppresses in-distribution boxes, and either restricts an existing anomaly map or prompts SAM for a binary mask; vanishing-point-guided Hungarian matching smooths video predictions. It reduces prior methods' FPR95 by up to 37.45%.

2026-07-20.title: Cross-Domain Demo-to-Code via Neurosymbolic Counterfactual Reasoning
2026-07-20.summary: NeSyCR abstracts video demonstrations into symbolic trajectories, derives counterfactual deployment states, and verifies procedural revisions before compiling executable code. It improves task success by 31.14% over Statler.

2026-07-20.title: TimeBridge: Self-Supervised Video Representation Learning via Start-End Joint Embedding and In-Between Frame Prediction
2026-07-20.summary: TimeBridge jointly embeds endpoint frames and reconstructs the frames between them, forcing explicit learning of nonlinear temporal transformations. It reports 73.5 J&F on DAVIS 2017 and 47.5 mIoU on VIP.

2026-07-20.title: Learning by Analogy: A Causal Framework for Compositional Generalization
2026-07-20.summary: This work explains compositional generalization through causal modularity and minimal changes, introducing an identifiable hierarchical process that supports complex non-additive concept interactions.

2026-07-20.title: DARC: Dual Adjustment Reasoning with Counterfactuals for Trustworthy Chest X-ray Classification
2026-07-20.summary: DARC separates non-pathological shortcuts and disease co-occurrence bias with back-door adjustment and anatomy-constrained counterfactual reasoning. CheXconf contains 40,213 instances across 11 categories.

2026-07-20.title: Learning for Transductive Threshold Calibration in Open-World Recognition
2026-07-20.summary: OpenGCN graphs unlabeled test instances, predicts pairwise connectivity, and transductively selects distance thresholds that satisfy target TPR or TNR for unseen open-world classes.

2026-07-22.title: Query2Uncertainty: Robust Uncertainty Quantification and Calibration for 3D Object Detection under Distribution Shift
2026-07-22.summary: Modern 3D detectors remain poorly calibrated under distribution shift because static post-hoc calibration only models in-distribution behavior. Query2Uncertainty fits a density estimator to class- and location-aware latent object queries from DETR-style detectors, then conditions post-hoc calibration on query density to jointly recalibrate classification confidence and bounding-box regression uncertainty. Experiments with camera-based PETR and LiDAR-based SECOND on nuScenes and MultiCorrupt consistently outperform standard post-hoc methods in both in-distribution and shifted settings.

2026-07-22.title: EvObj: Learning Evolving Object-centric Representations for 3D Instance Segmentation without Scene Supervision
2026-07-22.summary: EvObj targets unsupervised 3D instance segmentation when synthetic object priors transfer poorly to real scans because of morphology changes and occlusion. Its object discerning module continually refines object candidates and adapts priors to the target domain, while an object completion module reconstructs partial geometry after discovery. It achieves state-of-the-art results on real and synthetic datasets; on ScanNet++ it reports 42.0 AP, 69.3 AP50, and 82.7 AP25 versus 19.8, 35.6, and 48.1 for GrabS.

2026-07-22.title: PixDLM: A Dual-Path Multimodal Language Model for UAV Reasoning Segmentation
2026-07-22.summary: PixDLM defines UAV reasoning segmentation across spatial, attribute, and scene-level reasoning, and introduces DRSeg with 10,000 high-resolution UAV images, instance masks, and chain-of-thought QA. A low-resolution CLIP semantic path and high-resolution SAM perception path are linked by MultiPath Alignment and a hierarchical reasoning decoder. On DRSeg it reaches gIoU values of 62.80, 61.75, and 62.51 for attribute, scene, and spatial reasoning.

2026-07-22.title: R2-Seg: Training-Free OOD Medical Tumor Segmentation via Anatomical Reasoning and Statistical Rejection
2026-07-22.summary: R2-Seg addresses fragmented false positives produced by frozen medical segmentation foundation models on out-of-distribution tumors. Its training-free Reason stage uses an LLM anatomical planner to find organ anchors and multi-scale ROIs; the Reject stage applies two-sample statistical tests and false-discovery control to BiomedParse candidates, retaining regions unlike normal tissue. It substantially improves Dice, specificity, and sensitivity across multi-center, multi-modal benchmarks without parameter updates.

2026-07-22.title: Better than Average: Spatially-Aware Aggregation of Segmentation Uncertainty Improves Downstream Performance
2026-07-22.summary: Pixel-wise segmentation uncertainty must be reduced to an image score for OOD and failure detection, but global averaging erases localized boundary and structural evidence. This work analyzes common aggregators, introduces spatially aware strategies, and combines intensity and spatial signals with a GMM meta-aggregator. Across ten datasets, spatial and prediction-aware aggregation outperform global averaging, while GMM-All matches or beats individual-feature fits in six of ten settings.

2026-07-23.title: Unleashing Multimodal Large Language Models for Training-free HOI Detection in the Wild
2026-07-23.summary: AgentHOI is a training-free agentic framework for open-world human-object interaction detection. It coordinates foundation models through context-aware multi-round reasoning and multifaceted interaction localization, replacing fixed interaction classifiers with open-ended semantic discovery and instance-specific spatial grounding.

2026-07-23.title: TrustVLA: Mechanism-Guided Inference-Time Defense Against Vision-Language-Action Backdoors
2026-07-23.summary: TrustVLA identifies a compact causal footprint shared by visual-triggered VLA backdoors, then uses Dirichlet evidence evolution, counterfactual localization, and localized inpainting to detect and repair attacks at inference time without retraining.

2026-07-23.title: Slot-RAE: Streamlining Object-Centric Learning via Direct Representation Auto-Encoders
2026-07-23.summary: Slot-RAE learns object-centric decomposition directly in a frozen visual foundation model feature space. Slot Attention, a DiT feature decoder, and a REPA alignment head remove the need for external VAEs and pretrained text-to-image priors while retaining discovery, reconstruction, and compositional generalization.

2026-07-23.title: Promptable Concept Segmentation from Above: Evaluating SAM 3's Zero-Shot and One-Shot Capabilities in Remote Sensing
2026-07-23.summary: This study evaluates SAM 3 across remote-sensing classification, detection, and instance segmentation under zero-shot and one-shot constraints. It isolates five prompt configurations and exposes cross-modal interference, sub-pixel limits, and overhead semantic blind spots.

2026-07-23.title: Preserve the Hard, Regenerate the Rest: Uncertainty-Guided Synthetic Training Data Augmentation with Diffusion Models
2026-07-23.summary: This method uses predictive entropy to preserve difficult labeled pixels while diffusion inpaints only their complementary context. Fine-tuning excludes generated pixels from the loss, maintaining label validity while exposing rare UAV and street-scene objects to diverse backgrounds.

2026-07-24.title: Graph-to-Frame RAG: Visual-Space Knowledge Fusion for Training-Free and Auditable Video Reasoning
2026-07-24.summary: G2F-RAG builds a problem-agnostic video knowledge graph, retrieves a compact query-specific subgraph, and renders it as one reasoning frame for a frozen multimodal model. The visual-space representation improves Qwen2.5-VL-7B from 68.8/51.3/65.1 to 73.4/55.4/70.6 on MLVU, WildVideo, and VideoMME.

2026-07-24.title: Compositional Transformation Reasoning for Composed Video Retrieval
2026-07-24.summary: MoRe performs recall-oriented Pareto selection over visual, textual, and multimodal similarities, then uses an MLLM to compare candidates pairwise along entity, action, and scene transformations. It reaches 20.4 R@1 on EgoCVR and 63.0 R@1 on WebVid-CoVR in the zero-shot setting.

2026-07-24.title: Finding Distributed Object-Centric Properties in Self-Supervised Transformers
2026-07-24.summary: Object-DINO clusters attention heads using patch-level query, key, and value self-similarities across all transformer layers, then aggregates the object-centric cluster without task training. It improves unsupervised object discovery by 3.6 to 12.4 CorLoc points and reduces multimodal hallucination.

2026-07-24.title: Convexity-Aware Noise Calibration: A Self-Supervised Framework for Noise-Level-Unknown Image Denoising
2026-07-24.summary: CANC derives a convex relationship between additional synthetic AWGN and denoised-image variance, estimates the unknown noise level by ternary search, calibrates the estimate, and uses it to create supervised denoising pairs. At a true level of 25/255 it estimates 25.21/255 and nearly matches a known-noise DnCNN-S.

2026-07-24.title: GeometryCrafter: Consistent Geometry Estimation for Open-world Videos with Diffusion Priors
2026-07-24.summary: GeometryCrafter introduces a dual-encoder point-map VAE for unbounded geometry, aligns its latent space with Stable Video Diffusion, and conditions a video diffusion UNet on per-frame geometry priors. It achieves the best average rank across seven unseen point-map and depth benchmarks.

2026-07-25.title: Proof-of-Perception: Certified Tool-Using Multimodal Reasoning with Compositional Conformal Guarantees
2026-07-25.summary: PoP compiles multimodal reasoning into an executable DAG whose perception and logic nodes emit split-conformal candidate sets; a learned controller accepts, retries, expands, or aborts under a compute budget. On TextVQA it raises F1 from ProgVLM's 69.7 to 72.9, cuts hallucination from 15.1 to 9.3, and keeps node coverage near the 90% target.

2026-07-25.title: DPU: Dynamic Prototype Updating for Multimodal Out-of-Distribution Detection
2026-07-25.summary: DPU first learns cohesive but separated multimodal embeddings, then updates class prototypes according to within-batch variance and scales cross-modal prediction disagreement by sample-to-prototype similarity. Across two OOD tasks, five datasets, and nine base detectors, it reports near-OOD gains around 10% and far-OOD gains up to 80%; VIM FPR95 on HMDB51 to Kinetics600 falls from 13.68 to 0.01.

2026-07-25.title: Beyond Missing Modalities: Hypergraph Conditioned Diffusion for Uncertainty-Aware Multimodal Emotion Recognition
2026-07-25.summary: HyperEF uses masked hypergraph attention to encode high-order modality and dialogue-context relations, conditions a diffusion model to recover missing latent features, and fuses modality evidence with source-level and discriminative uncertainty. It leads all tested missing-rate settings; at 60% missingness it improves IEMOCAP6 accuracy from 55.5 to 59.5, while recovery MSE is far below the diffusion baseline.

2026-07-25.title: TerraScope: Pixel-Grounded Visual Reasoning for Earth Observation
2026-07-25.summary: TerraScope interleaves textual reasoning with explicit segmentation masks and reinjects masked optical, SAR, or temporal visual tokens into later reasoning steps. After grounding pretraining and Terra-CoT instruction tuning, it reaches 68.9, 73.9, and 46.5 on TerraScope-Bench, Landsat30-AU, and DisasterM3, versus 33.8, 45.7, and 23.6 for the original same-backbone setting.

2026-07-25.title: Seeing Through the Noise: Improving Infrared Small Target Detection and Segmentation from Noise Suppression Perspective
2026-07-25.summary: NS-FPN changes infrared small-target perception from feature amplification to noise suppression: LFP uses low-frequency guidance and gated Gaussian filtering to purify high-frequency responses, while SFS samples higher-level semantics along a learnable spiral prior. On IRSTD-1k it reaches 69.29 IoU, 95.24 Pd, and 8.58 Fa; on NUAA-SIRST it reaches 78.75 IoU, 100.0 Pd, and 1.60 Fa.

2026-07-26.title: RiskProp: Collision-Anchored Self-Supervised Risk Propagation For Early Accident Anticipation
2026-07-26.summary: RiskProp learns early accident risk without subjective anomaly-onset labels. It propagates collision-anchored logits backward with a stop-gradient future-frame target and regularizes sampled frame pairs with an adaptive monotonic margin. On CAP it reaches mAUC@0.1 0.483, mAP 0.890, and mTTA@0.1 1.207 seconds; on Nexar it improves mAUC@0.1 over CRASH by 0.079.

2026-07-26.title: Resilient Sensor Fusion under Adverse Sensor Failures via Multi-Modal Expert Fusion
2026-07-26.summary: MoME decouples LiDAR, camera, and fused 3D detection paths, then uses a locality-aware Adaptive Query Router to send each object query to one expert according to nearby sensor evidence. It reaches 71.2 mAP and 73.6 NDS on clean nuScenes, while improving limited-FOV mAP from CMT's 43.9 to 50.6 with only four milliseconds of reported decoder overhead.

2026-07-26.title: NAVER: A Neuro-Symbolic Compositional Automaton for Visual Grounding with Explicit Logic Reasoning
2026-07-26.summary: NAVER organizes perception, ProbLog generation, logic execution, answer verification, and return into a self-correcting deterministic finite-state automaton. Under a shared tool setting it cuts compositional pipeline failures to 0.3%, versus 10.3% for HYDRA and 70.2% for ViperGPT, while making intermediate entities, relations, rules, and retry paths auditable.

2026-07-26.title: Masked-Diffusion Autoencoders for 3D Medical Vision Representation Learning
2026-07-26.summary: MDAE corrupts 3D MRI with both variable block masking and diffusion noise, then trains a time-conditioned U-Net to reconstruct masked anatomy and denoise visible tissue against the same clean target. Pretraining on 114,570 volumes yields 73.6 mean in-distribution AUROC and 78.6 cross-sequence AUROC, versus MAE's 69.5 and 70.0, and reaches 81.4 Dice on BraTS18 segmentation.

2026-07-26.title: UAV-CB: A Complex-Background RGB-T Dataset and Local Frequency Bridge Network for UAV Detection
2026-07-26.summary: UAV-CB contributes 3,442 unregistered RGB-thermal pairs of small UAVs in building, vegetation, powerline, cloud, and ground backgrounds. LFBNet aligns local amplitude and phase, converts spectral discrepancy into a dense guidance map, and drives deformable spatial fusion. It reaches 84.6 AP50, 57.2 AP75, and 54.4 AP, improving C2Former by 5.3 AP.

2026-07-27.title: False Alarm Rectification for Early Smoke Segmentation
2026-07-27.summary: SmokeCPC combines MiT multi-scale features with DINOv3 global semantics through CFM, then shifts and temperature-scales pixel logits with an image-level smoke prior in CPCM. On SmokeSeg it reaches 61.83 IoU and 75.26 F1 while reducing image-level false positive rate to 0.28%.

2026-07-27.title: Hyperdimensional Uncertainty Quantification for Multimodal Uncertainty Fusion in Autonomous Vehicles Perception
2026-07-27.summary: HyperDUM projects modality features into fixed hyperdimensional spaces, builds scene-conditioned channel and patch prototypes, and uses cosine-similarity relations to gate sensor features before fusion. It reaches 66.70/66.00 average AP on aiMotive and 67.59 mIoU on DeLiVER with deterministic single-pass inference.

2026-07-27.title: MultiOOD: Scaling Out-of-Distribution Detection for Multiple Modalities
2026-07-27.summary: MultiOOD establishes a multimodal OOD benchmark and trains A2D to preserve true-class agreement while enlarging non-target prediction discrepancy; NP-Mix synthesizes proxy outliers between neighboring class prototypes. On UCF101 near-OOD, ASH FPR95 drops from 32.14 to 10.68 and AUROC rises from 94.02 to 97.80.

2026-07-27.title: Investigating Compositional Challenges in Vision-Language Models for Visual Grounding
2026-07-27.summary: ARPGrounding constructs 11,425 paired counterexamples across attribute, relation, and noun-priority grounding, then improves VLM compositionality by minimizing overlap between heatmaps from texts referring to different objects. ALBEF relation/priority accuracy rises from 29.19/14.94 to 38.65/24.21.

2026-07-27.title: DyFCLT: Dynamic Frequency-Decoupled Cross-Modal Learning Transformer for Multimodal Tiny Object Detection
2026-07-27.summary: DyFCLT dynamically partitions RGB-T query/key/value spectra into learnable radial bands for within-band cross-modal attention, then uses selective background smoothing and foreground-guided dynamic upsampling. It reaches 48.2 AP and 69.1 AP50 on RGBT-Tiny and 61.0 AP50 on RGBTDronePerson.

2026-07-28.title: Quantifying and Communicating Uncertainty in SAR-Based Flood Mapping via Density-Aware Neural Networks and Conformal Risk Control
2026-07-28.summary: 作者把谱归一化 UNet34、潜特征密度和两级共形风险控制连成洪水制图决策链：先以校准条件有效的密度 p 值拒绝分布外像素，再对保留像素输出风险受控的 Water/Nonwater 集合；密度 OOD AUROC 达 0.921，集合预测把平均漏覆盖率从 4.4% 降到 1.6%。

2026-07-28.title: Slot-BERT: Self-supervised Object Discovery in Surgical Video
2026-07-28.summary: Slot-BERT 先用递归 slot attention 建立邻帧对象候选，再以双向遮蔽 Temporal Slot Transformer 补全长程状态，并用 slot 去相似目标抑制对象合并；MICCAI 上 mBO-V、mBO-F、FG-ARI 和 CorLoc 分别达 48.9%、52.8%、58.2% 和 70.7%。

2026-07-28.title: Multimodal Learning on Low-Quality Data with Conformal Predictive Self-Calibration
2026-07-28.summary: CPSC 用共形预测同时处理模态不平衡与显式噪声：Representation Self-Calibration 选择可靠特征成分再融合，Gradient Self-Calibration 按实例可靠性重标定反向梯度，并让共形预测器随网络共同更新；CREMA-D 平均完整模态准确率达 78.65%。

2026-07-28.title: Enhanced OoD Detection through Cross-Modal Alignment of Multi-Modal Representations
2026-07-28.summary: 论文指出完整微调 CLIP 会扩大 ID 图像与 ID 文本的模态间隙，削弱负文本 OOD 分数；Cross-Modal Alignment 以双向 log-sum-exp 正则拉近两种 ID 表示，再接 NegLabel 检测，在 MOS 上平均 FPR95 19.93、AUROC 95.13。

2026-07-28.title: SafeDrive: Fine-Grained Safety Reasoning for End-to-End Driving in a Sparse World
2026-07-28.summary: SafeDrive 为每条候选自车轨迹构造实例级稀疏未来世界，再由 FRNet 逐对象、逐时刻计算碰撞风险并检查可行驶区域；NAVSIM PDMS/EPDMS 达 91.6/87.5，12,146 个场景仅 61 次碰撞，Bench2Drive Driving Score 为 66.77%。

2026-07-29.title: Anchor-Guided Gradient Alignment for Incomplete Multimodal Learning
2026-07-29.summary: ANGA 先以检索实例重建缺失模态，再用预测熵课程构造完整样本主导的动态优化锚点，并把偏离或冲突的重建样本梯度投影回可靠锥域；70% 缺失率下，HateMemes 文本缺失 AUROC 达 68.54，较 RAGPT 提高 4.44 点。

2026-07-29.title: Spatio-Temporal Conditional Denoising Transformer for Modality-Missing RGBT Tracking
2026-07-29.summary: SCDT 用同一个时空条件去噪器统一缺失模态重建和完整模态增强：强噪声迫使模型恢复缺失 RGB/TIR，弱噪声配合统计对齐细化完整输入，短期跨注意力与长期 FiLM 共同抑制漂移；LasHeR-Miss 达 69.3 PR/54.4 SR。

2026-07-29.title: SRA-Det: Learning Omni-Grained Open-Vocabulary Detection Beyond Category Names
2026-07-29.summary: SRA-Det 以多个可学习查询从 token 级描述中检索颜色、材质、部件和姿态等语义面，再用 soft-min 近似逻辑 AND，惩罚只满足部分属性的候选；FG-OVD 八个子集平均 54.9 mAP，较 OWL-ViT-L/14 提高 13.8 点。

2026-07-29.title: Synthetic Object Compositions for Scalable and Accurate Learning in Detection, Segmentation, and Grounding
2026-07-29.summary: SOC 从对象片段自底向上组装场景，以类别无关的三维深度和位置采样打破尺度捷径，再经扩散修复、全局重光照和面积加权回混保护标签与小目标细节；加入 50K 合成样本后 LVIS AP 从 20.1 升至 29.8，rare AP 从 10.1 升至 23.5。

2026-07-29.title: Towards Persistence: Learning Topological Constraints for Event-based Small Object Detection
2026-07-29.summary: SpTopoNet 在稀疏事件点云中同时学习局部邻域和全局轨迹拓扑，并以持久同调、几何匹配与阈值邻域主动梯度约束轨迹连续性；EV-UAV 上 IoU/Pd 达 66.62/83.36，Fa 降至 1.29×10^-4，明显优于 Ev-SpSegNet。

2026-07-30.title: Adaptive Confidence Regularization for Multimodal Failure Detection
2026-07-30.summary: ACR 把多模态融合置信度不应低于可靠单模态置信度写成自适应正则，并用连续特征块跨模态交换合成带软异常标签的内部冲突；HMDB51 的 AURC 从 MSP 的 29.56 降至 19.97，同时分类准确率由 86.20% 升至 87.23%。

2026-07-30.title: Uncertainty-Aware Modality Fusion for Unaligned RGB-T Salient Object Detection
2026-07-30.summary: UMFNet 不显式估计几何变换，而在像素级高斯潜空间中联合表示 RGB、热红外及残余错位不确定性，再以置信度控制通道调制和空间先验；UVT20K 的结构度量、增强对齐度量和加权 F 分别达到 0.890、0.918、0.836。

2026-07-30.title: UNI-OOD: Unified Object- and Image-level Out-of-Distribution Detection via Cross-Context Attentive Vision-Language Modeling
2026-07-30.summary: UNI-OOD 用共享冻结 CLIP 分别编码目标裁剪与掩蔽背景，以层头聚合注意力、视觉文本一致性和目标条件背景文本建模统一对象级与图像级 OOD；BDD100K 到 OpenImages 达到 98.52 AUROC、3.68 FPR95。

2026-07-30.title: Weakly Supervised Video Anomaly Detection with Anomaly-Connected Components and Intention Reasoning
2026-07-30.summary: LAS-VAD 以视觉和文本相似度修正的连通分量生成片段级伪标签，再用位置、速度、加速度意图特征与困难对比学习区分外观相似行为；XD-Violence 细粒度平均 mAP 达 36.89，UCF-Crime 达 15.62。

2026-07-30.title: Target-Aware Invertible Encoder with Reconstruction Guidance for Infrared Small Target Detection
2026-07-30.summary: InvDet 用 Haar 分解与可逆耦合保留微弱红外目标信息，只在逆向重建路径以 TARM 强化目标频率，并用几何-灰度容差图分配重建约束；IRSTD-1K、NUAA-SIRST、NUDT-SIRST 的 F1 分别为 84.4%、87.4%、86.2%。

2026-07-31.title: Distribution-Aligned Multimodal Fusion for Robust Object Detection
2026-07-31.summary: DAMF freezes a pretrained ViT-DETR detector and learns a lightweight RGB-infrared fusion module whose CLS feature is explicitly aligned to a GMM fitted on normal target-domain features. It reports 98.1, 79.5, and 57.8 mAP on LLVIP, FLIR, and DroneVehicle, while normal-distribution alignment generalizes better to unseen night and blur than degradation-distribution alignment.

2026-07-31.title: LATA: Laplacian-Assisted Transductive Adaptation for Conformal Uncertainty in Medical VLMs
2026-07-31.summary: LATA refines frozen medical VLM probabilities over the joint calibration-test pool with a deterministic kNN graph Laplacian update, then combines ViLU failure signals with split conformal prediction. At alpha 0.10 with APS it preserves 0.900 coverage while reducing average set size from 3.35 to 2.95 and class-conditioned coverage gap from 7.18 to 6.32.

2026-07-31.title: PostAlign: Multimodal Grounding as a Corrective Lens for MLLMs
2026-07-31.summary: MMGrounded-PostAlign adds explicit visual and textual grounding to an MLLM: a LOC token prompts SAM-based mask and box decoders, REJ handles absent referents, and SIMPLE or COMPLEX tokens select whether to generate a rationale. On HaloQuest the 7B model improves false-premise accuracy from 2.0 to 33.2 and insufficient-context accuracy from 2.5 to 31.4 without sacrificing general reasoning benchmarks.

2026-07-31.title: OpenDPR: Open-Vocabulary Change Detection via Vision-Centric Diffusion-Guided Prototype Retrieval for Remote Sensing Imagery
2026-07-31.summary: OpenDPR separates open-vocabulary remote-sensing change detection into class-agnostic proposal generation and vision-centric category retrieval. It constructs reusable DINOv2 prototypes from diffusion-synthesized, APE-localized support images and reports 44.8 and 54.3 IoU on LEVIR-CD and WHU-CD without training; its weakly supervised S2C variant reaches 48.1 and 68.3 IoU.

2026-07-31.title: Tri-Modal Fusion Transformers for UAV-based Object Detection
2026-07-31.summary: This CVPR 2026 study builds a synchronized RGB-LWIR-event UAV benchmark and a dual-stream MiT detector. MAGE gates cross-sensor channel and spatial residuals, BiTE performs symmetric token exchange, and an unchanged FPN/Faster R-CNN head isolates fusion effects across 61 ablations. The MiT-B1 tri-modal model reaches 84.24 mAP, versus 83.42 for RGB-thermal and 66.32 for RGB-event.

2026-08-01.title: Think Before You Drive: World Model-Inspired Multimodal Grounding
2026-08-01.summary: ThinkDeeper combines monocular depth-modulated grounding, recurrent latent refinement, and a cross-modal hypergraph decoder for driving instructions. It reaches 77.27 IoU@0.5 on DrivePilot, but its rollout is supervised by the current mask rather than future observations, so the world-model interpretation remains unproven.

2026-08-01.title: MUST: Modality-Specific Representation-Aware Transformer for Diffusion-Enhanced Survival Prediction with Missing Modality
2026-08-01.summary: MUST decomposes pathology and genomics representations into low-rank shared and modality-specific components, algebraically recovers the shared part, and uses conditional latent diffusion only for the missing specific residual. Across five TCGA cohorts it reports C-index 0.742 complete, 0.716 missing genomics, and 0.739 missing pathology.

2026-08-01.title: VideoICL: Confidence-based Iterative In-context Learning for Out-of-Distribution Video Understanding
2026-08-01.summary: VideoICL retrieves text-video demonstrations, feeds them to a frozen video LMM in small batches, and retries until minimum token probability crosses a threshold. LLaVA-Video-7B improves by up to 54.6 percentage points on OOD tasks, although the score controls computation rather than calibrated abstention or risk.

2026-08-01.title: Event-based Tiny Object Detection: A Benchmark Dataset and Baseline
2026-08-01.summary: EV-UAV supplies 147 event-camera sequences with targets averaging 6.8 by 5.4 pixels. EV-SpSegNet combines grouped dilated sparse convolutions, patch attention, and a spatiotemporal-correlation-weighted loss, reaching 55.18 IoU, 77.53 Pd, and 1.63e-4 Fa with 4.0M parameters.

2026-08-01.title: SET: Spectral Enhancement for Tiny Object Detection
2026-08-01.summary: SET uses training-only ground-truth-guided background smoothing and feature-level adversarial perturbations to strengthen tiny-object evidence without changing the inference detector. It raises RFLA from 21.7 to 24.9 AP and DINO-5scale from 23.2 to 26.6 on AI-TOD, at a substantial training-time cost.

2026-08-02.title: Multi-modal Test-time Adaptation via Adaptive Probabilistic Gaussian Calibration
2026-08-02.summary: AdaPGC maintains class-conditional Gaussian statistics for every modality during streaming test-time adaptation, detects the less reliable view through posterior disagreement, and updates only that view against a stop-gradient reliable anchor. It reaches 66.1/73.2 accuracy on Kinetics50-C video/audio corruptions.

2026-08-02.title: Uncertainty-Driven Expert Control: Enhancing the Reliability of Medical Vision-Language Models
2026-08-02.summary: Expert-CFG uses normalized token predictive entropy to route only uncertain medical VQA answers to an expert, then injects highlighted clinical evidence through classifier-free guidance without retraining. With 5% intervention, Phi3.5V-Med improves overall accuracy by 2.66, 2.55, and 4.32 points on three benchmarks.

2026-08-02.title: Uncertainty-Aware Gradient Stabilization for Small Object Detection
2026-08-02.summary: UGS explains small-object localization failure through scale-dependent sharp loss curvature, then replaces regression with non-uniform discretized classification, entropy minimization, and adversarial uncertainty refinement. It lifts DINO-5scale from 35.5 to 38.1 AP on VisDrone and reduces small-anchor gradient variance by 2.9x.

2026-08-02.title: DarkAct: A RGB-Thermal Dataset and Fusion Framework for Multimodal Low-Light Action Recognition
2026-08-02.summary: DarkAct introduces 12,778 paired RGB-thermal low-light videos and DarkAct-Net, whose motion-aware attention tolerates sensor misalignment and whose light-adaptive fusion reweights cross-modal evidence at every transformer stage. It reaches 74.4 Top-1, while all tested zero-shot VLMs remain below 20%.

2026-08-02.title: Conformal Prediction and MLLM aided Uncertainty Quantification in Scene Graph Generation
2026-08-02.summary: PC-SGG applies class-conditional conformal prediction to object and predicate heads, forms triplet prediction sets, and uses an MLLM to remove implausible relations. The filter halves set size with little coverage loss, but no tested SGG model reaches the nominal triplet guarantee, exposing exchangeability and calibration failures.

2026-08-03.title: VGent: Visual Grounding via Modular Design for Disentangling Reasoning and Prediction
2026-08-03.summary: VGent keeps an MLLM frozen as a reasoning encoder and lets a detector-conditioned decoder select proposals in parallel, avoiding autoregressive box hallucination. QuadThinker, mask-aware labels, and global target recognition improve multi-target grounding; it reports +20.58 F1, +8.22 gIoU, and +5.83 cIoU over prior best results.

2026-08-03.title: Cross-modal Causal Relation Alignment for Video Question Grounding
2026-08-03.summary: CRA weakly supervises video question grounding with Gaussian-smoothed temporal attention, bidirectional QA-segment contrastive alignment, and explicit front-door visual/back-door linguistic interventions. It raises NextGQA grounded-answer accuracy to 18.2 and STAR grounded-answer accuracy to 26.8 without interval labels.

2026-08-03.title: Zero-Shot Compositional Video Learning with Coding Rate Reduction
2026-08-03.summary: This method uses a latent-query resampler and coding-rate reduction to separate spatial object concepts from temporal action concepts before recomposition. It reaches 52.4 unseen accuracy and 42.6 harmonic mean on Sth-Com, and 74.0 unseen mAP on CATER using only RGB video.

2026-08-03.title: Fusion Meets Diverse Conditions: A High-diversity Benchmark and Baseline for UAV-based Multimodal Object Detection with Condition Cues
2026-08-03.summary: ATR-UMOD supplies 13,353 aligned UAV RGB-IR pairs with six condition labels, while PCDF turns those conditions into prompts, decouples condition information at test time, and dynamically gates modality contributions. It achieves 63.3 mAP@0.5, 3.3 points above the strongest reported comparator.

2026-08-03.title: RoboFireFuseNet: Robust Fusion of Visible and Infrared Wildfire Imaging for Real-Time Flame and Smoke Segmentation
2026-08-03.summary: RoboFireFuseNet fuses visible and infrared wildfire imagery with modality-specific paths, channel attention, SwinV2 semantic processing, detail-preserving skips, Lovasz-Softmax, copy-paste, and modality dropout. It reports 81.5 flame IoU, 87.98 smoke IoU, 88.17 mIoU, and 29.5M parameters.

2026-08-04.title: From Easy to Hard: Progressive Active Learning Framework for Infrared Small Target Detection with Single Point Supervision
2026-08-04.summary: PAL turns single-point infrared small-target supervision into a progressive curriculum: it pre-starts on automatically selected easy samples, admits harder cases through a coarse outer update, and refines pseudo-masks with a decay-controlled fine inner update. Across several SIRST backbones it substantially narrows the gap to full supervision.

2026-08-04.title: U2Flow: Uncertainty-Aware Unsupervised Optical Flow Estimation
2026-08-04.summary: U2Flow jointly predicts recurrent optical flow and per-pixel uncertainty without flow ground truth. Augmentation inconsistency supplies a detached residual for a Laplace likelihood objective; the learned uncertainty then gates refinement, regional smoothness, reliable correspondence selection, and bidirectional flow fusion.

2026-08-04.title: Visual Prototype Conditioned Focal Region Generation for UAV-Based Object Detection
2026-08-04.summary: UAVGen conditions diffusion on class prototypes and focal-region layouts, then repairs missing, extra, and misaligned synthetic labels before detector training. It raises GFL mAP from 24.5 to 25.9 on VisDrone and from 14.5 to 16.6 on UAVDT with far fewer synthetic full images than competing generators.

2026-08-04.title: What You Have is What You Track: Adaptive and Robust Multimodal Tracking
2026-08-04.summary: FlexTrack routes incomplete RGB-X video through heterogeneous experts of different capacity and trains with a structured video-level modality mask. It preserves temporal continuity under sensor gaps, improves complete-modality tracking by 2.6%, and gains 3.8 and 6.5 points on two missing-modality ablations.

2026-08-04.title: FlameFinder: Illuminating Obscured Fire Through Smoke With Attentive Deep Metric Learning
2026-08-04.source: IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing 62 (2024)
2026-08-04.summary: FlameFinder learns paired RGB-thermal flame prototypes on unobscured UAV imagery and uses attentive center, triplet-center, and cosine metric losses to classify thermal patches behind smoke. It improves unobscured flame accuracy by 4.4 points on FLAME2 and 7 points on FLAME3 while reducing thermal hot-spot confusion.

2026-08-05.title: Detection-Friendly Nonuniformity Correction: A Union Framework for Infrared UAV Target Detection
2026-08-05.summary: UniCD jointly optimizes infrared nonuniformity correction and UAV target detection instead of treating restoration as an independent front end. GBFE and LBFE estimate a smooth bias field, TEBS protects target evidence at four detector stages, and backbone representation alignment keeps corrected features close to clean-image features. On real IRBFD it reaches 0.994 precision and 0.901 recall; TEBS raises recall from 0.762 to 0.810.

2026-08-05.title: Quantifying and Enhancing Multi-modal Robustness with Modality Preference
2026-08-05.summary: CRMT explains multimodal fragility through modality preference: a model can over-rely on the most informative modality, leaving other unimodal margins narrow and attacks on the preferred stream unusually effective. It derives certified multimodal and unimodal robustness bounds, introduces orthogonal unimodal classifiers, enlarges the unreliable-modality margin, and then adjusts modality integration to maximize the certified bound. On Kinetics-Sounds, CRMT-AT reports 0.626 accuracy when the preferred modality is missing and 0.464 under an L2 attack on that modality.

2026-08-05.title: Open-Vocabulary Domain Generalization in Urban-Scene Segmentation
2026-08-05.summary: S2-Corr defines open-vocabulary domain-generalized urban segmentation, where both the deployment domain and part of the vocabulary are unseen. It replaces noise-amplifying correlation attention with selective state-space aggregation, then adds image/text-conditioned modulation, a learnable geometric decay, and chunk-wise snake scanning. With a ViT-B backbone it reaches 50.3 and 47.9 mIoU on Dv-19 and Dv-58, improving the strongest prior results by 4.3 and 2.9 points.

2026-08-05.title: H2ST: Hierarchical Two-Sample Tests for Continual Out-of-Distribution Detection
2026-08-05.summary: H2ST reformulates continual OOD detection in task-incremental learning as a hierarchy of classifier two-sample tests. Each task-specific layer compares replayed source features with a target stream, updates a source-target classifier online, and uses a Clopper-Pearson interval for calibrated accept/reject decisions; early exit identifies the task while rejection by every layer marks OOD. With GEM it reports 89.12 F1 and 89.10 task accuracy, 23.23 and 20.40 points above the second-best method.

2026-08-05.title: Object-centric Video Question Answering with Visual Grounding and Referring
2026-08-05.summary: RGA3 unifies object-centric video question answering with spatial-temporal grounding. STOM propagates an arbitrary visual prompt from any timestamp and alpha-composites it onto every frame; Qwen2.5-VL then reasons over the overlaid video, while a SEG-token hidden state conditions a SAM2 decoder for masks. VideoInfer contains 1,620 videos and 28,811 QA pairs. RGA3-7B reaches 46.7 GPT-4o accuracy and 2.60 score, versus 43.6 and 2.46 without STOM.

2026-08-06.title: Linking Modality Isolation in Heterogeneous Collaborative Perception
2026-08-06.summary: CodeAlign studies modality isolation, where heterogeneous agents never co-occur in any training frame and correspondence-based alignment is therefore impossible. It learns per-modality codebooks and feature-code-feature translators that map a source feature into a target code map and decode it in the target feature space without paired scenes. Communicating discrete indices costs 0.03 MB, 1024 times less than 32 MB dense features; in three-modality collaboration it uses 8% of HEAL's alignment parameters and improves several DAIR-V2X AP30 results by more than eight points.

2026-08-06.title: TTL: Test-time Textual Learning for OOD Detection with Pretrained Vision-Language Models
2026-08-06.summary: TTL adapts the textual side of a pretrained vision-language model to the unlabeled deployment stream instead of relying on a fixed negative-class vocabulary. It learns class-specific OOD prompts from pseudo-labeled samples, purifies low-confidence boundary cases, and accumulates reliable prompt features in an OOD Textual Knowledge Bank for cross-batch calibration. Across two standard protocols and nine OOD datasets, the authors report average gains of 12.67 FPR95 points and 3.94 AUROC points; on the ImageNet benchmark TTL reaches 12.46 FPR95 and 97.29 AUROC.

2026-08-06.title: SPAR: Single-Pass Any-Resolution ViT for Open-vocabulary Segmentation
2026-08-06.summary: SPAR compresses the dense spatial quality of an overlapping sliding-window foundation-model teacher into a single-pass arbitrary-resolution ViT student. The frozen teacher stitches fine-grained window features, while the student regresses the aligned feature map on 25K unlabeled SA-1B images and normally updates only its final two transformer blocks. It improves SigLIP2 and OpenCLIP single-pass baselines by 10.5 and 6.7 mean-mIoU points on six open-vocabulary segmentation datasets while running up to 52 times faster than the sliding teacher.

2026-08-06.title: PointSR: Self-Regularized Point Supervision for Drone-View Object Detection
2026-08-06.summary: PointSR addresses unstable pseudo-box generation from point labels in dense drone imagery. Its Temporal-Ensembling Encoder builds an epoch-spanning anchor prototype library, coarse prediction adjusts anchors and collects high-loss informative negatives, and refinement uses those negatives to suppress ambiguous positive proposals. It reaches AP50 values of 42.5, 38.7, and 35.0 on DroneVehicle, UAVDT, and VisDrone, improving the strongest reported point-supervised baselines by 7.2, 5.4, and 2.6 points while also reducing sensitivity to point perturbation.

2026-08-06.title: SmokeBench: Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models for Wildfire Smoke Detection
2026-08-06.summary: SmokeBench evaluates MLLMs on a progression from smoke classification to tile localization, grid localization, and bounding-box detection. It stratifies results by smoke area and Weber contrast, revealing that large smoke volume strongly improves recognition whereas contrast has a much smaller effect. GPT-4o reaches 0.931 classification accuracy for the very-large area bin, but localization remains weak and general-purpose box outputs are near zero IoU, exposing a safety-critical gap for transparent, amorphous early smoke.

2026-08-07.title: ReasonGrounder: LVLM-Guided Hierarchical Feature Splatting for Open-Vocabulary 3D Visual Grounding and Reasoning
2026-08-07.summary: ReasonGrounder separates implicit-language reasoning from 3D localization. An LVLM first rewrites a reasoning instruction into explicit object concepts; SAM masks and multi-view CLIP features are then distilled into scale-specific 3D Gaussian feature fields, whose hierarchical groups support both visible and occluded target localization. The accompanying ReasoningGD benchmark contains over 10K scenes and two million annotations. On the implicit subset, the paper reports 25.98 mIoU and 40.02 precision at IoU 0.25, substantially exceeding the strongest compared open-vocabulary 3D baseline.

2026-08-07.title: RobSense: A Robust Multi-modal Foundation Model for Remote Sensing with Static, Temporal, and Incomplete Data Adaptability
2026-08-07.summary: RobSense addresses remote-sensing models that assume a fixed set of complete multispectral and SAR observations. Phase one combines date-of-year encoding, symmetric temporal-distribution alignment, and masked reconstruction to learn a shared temporal multimodal representation. Phase two freezes that representation and trains latent reconstructors to recover complete features from missing bands or dates. It reports 46.36 mIoU for complete MS-SAR segmentation and 44.26 under random missing data, while BigEarthNet complete/random-missing mAP reaches 88.17/84.87.

2026-08-07.title: Weakly Misalignment-free Adaptive Feature Alignment for UAVs-based Multimodal Object Detection
2026-08-07.summary: OAFA targets weak RGB-thermal registration in UAV detection without requiring offset labels. CSOM decomposes each modality into common and specific subspaces using central-moment similarity, difference, and auxiliary detection objectives; ODAF predicts a basic cross-modal offset plus local deformable offsets and modulation masks, then fuses aligned common and modality-specific features. A two-stage schedule prevents unstable alignment from corrupting early semantics. On DroneVehicle it reaches 79.4 mAP at IoU 0.4 and 33.1 FPS, 3.3 points above the reported runner-up.

2026-08-07.title: WiSE-OD: Benchmarking Robustness in Infrared Object Detection
2026-08-07.summary: WiSE-OD introduces LLVIP-C and FLIR-C to measure infrared detector robustness across 14 corruptions, and separates synthetic corruption from natural day-to-fog/rain/night/indoor shifts on M3FD. Its deployment-time model linearly interpolates a broad RGB COCO endpoint with an infrared-adapted endpoint, producing one detector with no extra online inference. Faster R-CNN reaches 75.08/75.83 mPC on LLVIP-C for the zero-shot/linear-probe variants versus 56.40 for full fine-tuning, but still collapses on severe low contrast and is not an OOD rejection method.

2026-08-07.title: SCOT: Self-Supervised Contrastive Pretraining for Zero-Shot Compositional Retrieval
2026-08-07.summary: SCOT learns compositional image retrieval without labeled query-image, modification-text, and target-image triplets. An LLM rewrites web image captions into source descriptions and relative modifications; a composition network combines the source image with the modification, while the frozen vision-language text embedding of the original caption serves as a proxy target. Contrastive training on large image-text pairs yields a transferable zero-shot composition function. The paper reports average FashionIQ R@10/R@50 of 34.08/56.38 and CIRR R@1 of 25.70, outperforming prior zero-shot methods and several supervised baselines.

2026-08-08.title: Geo3DVQA: Evaluating Vision-Language Models for 3D Geospatial Reasoning from Aerial Imagery
2026-08-08.summary: Three-dimensional geospatial analysis is critical to applications in urban planning, climate adaptation, and environmental assessment. Current methodologies depend on costly, specialized sensors (e.g., LiDAR and multispectral), which restrict global accessibility. Existing sensor-based and rule-driven methods further struggle with tasks requiring the integration of multiple 3D cues, handling diverse queries, and providing interpretable reasoning. We hereby present Geo3DVQA, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating vision-language models (VLMs) in height-aware, 3D geospatial reasoning using RGB-only remote sensing imagery. Unlike conventional sensor-based frameworks, Geo3DVQA emphasizes realistic scenarios that integrate elevation, sky view factors, and land cover patterns. The benchmark encompasses 110k curated question-answer pairs spanning 16 task categories across three complexity levels: single-feature inference, multi-feature reasoning, and application-level spatial analysis. The evaluation of ten state-of-the-art VLMs highlights the difficulty of RGB-to-3D reasoning. GPT-4o and Gemini-2.5-Flash achieved only 28.6% and 33.0% accuracy respectively, while domain-specific fine-tuning of Qwen2.5-VL-7B achieved 49.6% (+24.8 points). These results reveal both the limitations of current VLMs and the effectiveness of domain adaptation. Geo3DVQA introduces a new frontier of challenges for scalable, accessible, and holistic 3D geospatial analysis. The dataset and code will be released upon publication at https://github.com/mm1129/Geo3DVQA.

2026-08-08.title: UCDSC: Open Set UnCertainty aware Deep Simplex Classifier for Medical Image Datasets
2026-08-08.summary: Driven by advancements in deep learning, computer-aided diagnoses have made remarkable progress. However, outside controlled laboratory settings, algorithms may encounter several challenges. In the medical domain, these difficulties often stem from limited data availability due to ethical and legal restrictions, as well as the high cost and time required for expert annotations--especially in the face of emerging or rare diseases. In this context, open-set recognition plays a vital role by identifying whether a sample belongs to one of the known classes seen during training or should be rejected as an unknown. Recent studies have shown that features learned in the later stages of deep neural networks are observed to cluster around their class means, which themselves are arranged as individual vertices of a regular simplex [32]. The proposed method introduces a loss function designed to reject samples of unknown classes effectively by penalizing open space regions using auxiliary datasets. This approach achieves significant performance gain across four MedMNIST datasets--BloodMNIST, OCTMNIST, DermaMNIST, TissueMNIST and a publicly available skin dataset[29] outperforming state-of-the-art techniques.

2026-08-08.title: Unified Framework for Open-World Compositional Zero-Shot Learning
2026-08-08.summary: Open-World Compositional Zero-Shot Learning (OW-CZSL) addresses the challenge of recognizing novel compositions of known primitives and entities. Even though prior works utilize language knowledge for recognition such approaches exhibit limited interactions between language-image modalities. Our approach primarily focuses on enhancing the inter-modality interactions through fostering richer interactions between image and textual data. Additionally we introduce a novel module aimed at alleviating the computational burden associated with exhaustive exploration of all possible compositions during the inference stage. While previous methods exclusively learn compositions jointly or independently we introduce an advanced hybrid procedure that leverages both learning mechanisms to generate final predictions. Our proposed model achieves state-of-the-art in OW-CZSL in three datasets while surpassing Large Vision Language Models (LLVM) in two datasets. Our code is available at https://github.com/hirunima/OWCZSL

2026-08-08.title: UNO: Unifying One-stage Video Scene Graph Generation via Object-Centric Visual Representation Learning
2026-08-08.summary: Video Scene Graph Generation (VidSGG) aims to represent dynamic visual content by detecting objects and modeling their temporal interactions as structured graphs. Prior studies typically target either coarse-grained box-level or fine-grained panoptic pixel-level VidSGG, often requiring task-specific architectures and multi-stage training pipelines. In this paper, we present UNO (UNified Object-centric VidSGG), a single-stage, unified framework that jointly addresses both tasks within an end-to-end architecture. UNO is designed to minimize task-specific modifications and maximize parameter sharing, enabling generalization across different levels of visual granularity. The core of UNO is an extended slot attention mechanism that decomposes visual features into object and relation slots. To ensure robust temporal modeling, we introduce object temporal consistency learning, which enforces consistent object representations across frames without relying on explicit tracking modules. Additionally, a dynamic triplet prediction module links relation slots to corresponding object pairs, capturing evolving interactions over time. We evaluate UNO on standard box-level and pixel-level VidSGG benchmarks. Results demonstrate that UNO not only achieves competitive performance across both tasks but also offers improved efficiency through a unified, object-centric design.

2026-08-08.title: MUSE: Model-based Uncertainty-aware Similarity Estimation for zero-shot 2D Object Detection and Segmentation
2026-08-08.summary: MUSE 在无需训练的 BOP 零样本检测/分割中，把 Grounding DINO 与 SAM2 候选、DINOv2 全局和局部特征、GeM 聚合、跨类别相对相似度及候选 objectness 先验组合成可解释排序，在 BOP 2025 Classic Core 上报告检测 AP 0.533、分割 AP 0.525。

2026-08-09.title: UniGeoSeg: Towards Unified Open-World Segmentation for Geospatial Scenes
2026-08-09.summary: Instruction-driven segmentation in remote sensing generates masks from guidance, offering great potential for accessible and generalizable applications. Existing methods, however, fragment referring, interactive, and reasoning segmentation and lack sufficiently broad instruction data. UniGeoSeg introduces GeoSeg-1M with 590K images, 117 categories, and 1.1M image-mask-instruction triplets, then combines task-aware text enhancement, latent knowledge memory, and progressive training in one framework. It achieves state-of-the-art results on GeoSeg-Bench and public benchmarks while showing strong zero-shot generalization.

2026-08-09.title: Prior2Former - Evidential Modeling of Mask Transformers for Assumption-Free Open-World Panoptic Segmentation
2026-08-09.summary: Prior2Former extends Mask2Former with evidential Beta priors over pixel-wise binary mask assignments. It estimates positive and negative evidence for each mask, samples uncertain pixels during training, and combines mask evidence with class confidence to identify and cluster unknown objects. Unlike most open-world segmentation systems, it uses neither OOD samples, void-class supervision, nor external foundation models. Experiments on Cityscapes, COCO, SegmentMeIfYouCan, and OoDIS report state-of-the-art anomaly-instance and open-world panoptic results under this assumption-free setting.

2026-08-09.title: SCOD: From Heuristics to Theory
2026-08-09.summary: SCOD studies selective classification when test data mixes in-distribution examples, including hard misclassifications, with out-of-distribution samples. The paper proves that the optimal selector is a stochastic linear rule in a two-dimensional space defined by conditional classification risk and the OOD-to-ID likelihood ratio, and that ID data alone is insufficient for distribution-free PAC learning. POSCOD estimates this rule from labeled ID data plus an unlabeled ID/OOD mixture and substantially improves risk-coverage behavior over single-score OOD methods and SIRC.

2026-08-09.title: SimMLM: A Simple Framework for Multi-modal Learning with Missing Modality
2026-08-09.summary: SimMLM addresses deployment-time modality absence without synthesizing missing data or imposing a task-specific fusion architecture. A Dynamic Mixture of Modality Experts processes available inputs with modality-specific experts and a learned gate, while the More-vs-Fewer ranking loss enforces that adding modalities should not worsen task loss. Across BraTS 2018 segmentation and UPMC Food-101 and avMNIST classification, the framework improves complete- and missing-modality accuracy, robustness, interpretability, and reliability over competitive methods.

2026-08-09.title: Text-IRSTD: Leveraging Semantic Text to Promote Infrared Small Target Detection in Complex Scenes
2026-08-09.summary: Text-IRSTD reformulates infrared small-target detection as text-guided segmentation because a few bright pixels often cannot distinguish targets from clutter. It introduces fuzzy prompts that describe the interested region and scene rather than an unreliable object class, and a progressive cross-modal semantic interaction decoder with text-guided feature aggregation and semantic interaction blocks. The accompanying FZDT benchmark contains 2,755 infrared images with fuzzy text annotations; experiments report stronger contour recovery, clutter suppression, and cross-dataset generalization.

2026-08-10.title: FE-CLIP: Frequency Enhanced CLIP Model for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection and Segmentation
2026-08-10.summary: FE-CLIP injects localized frequency evidence into a frozen CLIP visual encoder through complementary DCT reconstruction and frequency-statistics adapters. It improves zero-shot anomaly classification and segmentation across industrial and medical datasets while training only lightweight adapters.

2026-08-10.title: Synthesizing Near-Boundary OOD Samples for Out-of-Distribution Detection
2026-08-10.summary: SynOOD generates hard OOD samples near the in-distribution boundary by iteratively optimizing diffusion noise against an OOD score, then uses the paired samples to adapt CLIP image projections and negative text features. The design targets the boundary cases that conventional far-OOD negatives fail to represent.

2026-08-10.title: Talking to DINO: Bridging Self-Supervised Vision Backbones with Language for Open-Vocabulary Segmentation
2026-08-10.summary: Talk2DINO nonlinearly warps CLIP text embeddings into DINOv2's dense visual space using image-caption supervision and DINO attention heads as region selectors. The frozen backbones then support open-vocabulary segmentation, with a separate attention-based background cleaning procedure.

2026-08-10.title: Rotation Invariant and Symmetry Aware Pixel Difference Network for Remote Sensing Object Detection
2026-08-10.summary: RIS-PiDiNet builds remote-sensing detectors around a rotation-invariant, symmetry-aware pixel-difference convolution. Polar harmonic kernels model continuous rotations, discrete response averaging approximates invariance, and symmetry-aware local differences preserve structure under rotation and partial occlusion.

2026-08-10.title: Delving Aleatoric Uncertainty in Medical Image Segmentation via Vision Foundation Models
2026-08-10.summary: This work estimates sample-level aleatoric uncertainty from the singular-value energy distribution of frozen medical foundation-model features. The resulting score supports noisy-sample filtering and a dynamic uncertainty-aware objective that combines class reweighting with learnable label denoising.
